{{Current events|year=2019|month=10|day=11|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict]]
**[[The Pentagon]] announces the deployment of 1,000 to 3,000 [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. troops]] to [[Saudi Arabia]] to deter Iranian aggression. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/11/politics/us-additional-troops-middle-east-iran/index.html (CNN)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/thousands-us-troops-deploying-saudi-arabia-pentagon/story?id=66211563 (ABC News)]
**[[Iran]] claims one of its oil tankers was hit in the [[Red Sea]], likely by missiles. The [[Saudi Ports Authority]] confirms an incident with a tanker near the port of [[Jeddah]] overnight. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-iran-tanker/iran-oil-tanker-hit-by-two-missiles-off-saudi-coast-iranian-state-media-idUSKBN1WQ0G0 (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]]
**A [[car bomb]] detonates in the [[Syria]]n city of [[Qamishli]], killing three and injuring nine. The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-blast/car-bomb-hits-syrian-kurdish-held-city-of-qamishli-sdf-official-idUSKBN1WQ1QK (Reuters)]
**Five [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] prisoners escape a [[Syrian Democratic Forces]]-run prison near [[Kobanî]], [[Syria]], after being shelled by [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-escape/sdf-five-islamic-state-fighters-escape-jail-in-syrias-qamishli-idUSKBN1WQ270 (Reuters)] [https://metro.co.uk/2019/10/11/isis-prisoners-break-syrian-jail-following-turkish-bombing-raid-10904487/ (''Metro'')]
**Turkish artillery mistakenly hits a contingent of [[United States special operations forces]] on Mashtenour hill in the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-majority city of Kobanî, according to a senior [[United States Department of Defense|Department of Defense]] official. [https://www.newsweek.com/us-troops-syria-turkey-1464727 (''Newsweek'')]
**A [[People's Protection Units|YPG]] [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar]] and rocket attack on the [[Turkey|Turkish]] town of [[Nusaybin]] kills eight civilians and injures 35 others, according to the governor of [[Mardin Province]]. [https://reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-turkey-nusaybin/eight-killed-in-turkish-border-town-in-ypg-attack-governors-office-idUKKBN1WQ2DI (Reuters)]
*[[Burkina Faso mosque attack]] 
**Gunmen kill 16 people during prayers in a northern [[Burkina Faso]] [[mosque]]. [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/gunmen-kill-15-people-attack-burkina-faso-mosque-1608738-2019-10-12 (Reuters via ''India Today'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Ethiopian Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] wins the 2019 [[Nobel Peace Prize]] for his [[2018 Eritrea–Ethiopia summit|efforts to make peace]] between [[Ethiopia]] and  neighbouring [[Eritrea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nobel-prize-peace/ethiopian-pm-abiy-ahmed-wins-2019-nobel-peace-prize-idUSKBN1WQ12I (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Thierry Bolloré]] is fired with immediate effect as the number two of the [[Renault]] group, reportedly after a power struggle with its president [[Jean-Dominique Senard]]. [https://www.liberation.fr/france/2019/10/11/thierry-bollore-numero-deux-de-renault-ejecte-sans-menagement_1756942 (''Libération'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-50016532 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute]]
**[[Japan]] and [[South Korea]] hold the first round of talks in [[Geneva]] to address a South Korea complaint with [[World Trade Organization]] over Japanese export controls. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20191011009200320 (Yonhap)]
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**[[China]] and the [[United States]] announced a tentative agreement for the "first phase" of a trade deal, with China agreeing to buy up to [[United States dollar|$]]50 billion in American farm products with the United States agreeing to suspend new tariffs scheduled for October 15. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/trump-strikes-upbeat-notes-on-trade-talks-11570804097 (''Wall Street Journal'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A cargo plane carrying [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|presidential]] staff crashes in eastern [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], killing all eight passengers and crew onboard. The [[Russia]]n embassy in [[Kinshasa]] says "preliminary information" indicates [[Russians]] were on the aircraft. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-crash/cargo-plane-crashes-in-congo-with-presidential-staff-on-board-idUSKBN1WQ1IV (Reuters)] 
*[[Saddleridge Fire]]
**A [[wildfire]] destroys 25 homes, displaces 100,000 people and burns over 7,500 acres of forest in and around [[Los Angeles]]. [https://www.npr.org/2019/10/11/769352277/25-homes-more-than-4-700-acres-burn-in-saddleridge-fire-near-los-angeles (NPR)]

;Law and crime
*[[Manchester Arndale stabbing]]
**Four people are stabbed and injured, one critically, in a [[mass stabbing]] at the [[Manchester Arndale]] shopping centre in [[Northern Quarter (Manchester)|the Northern Quarter]], [[Manchester]], [[United Kingdom]]. Another person was injured but not stabbed. A man in his early 40s is arrested. He was arrested under the Mental Health Act. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-manchester-50025301 (BBC News)]
*One [[Dutch people|Dutch]] person and two [[Afghans]] are remanded in custody for [[manslaughter]] and assistance to [[illegal immigrant]]s staying in [[France]], after they sold places in inflatable boats for them to reach [[Great Britain]], causing the death of an [[Iranian peoples|Iranian]] woman on 9 August. [https://www.lavoixdunord.fr/650487/article/2019-10-12/trois-passeurs-presumes-devant-la-justice-apres-la-mort-d-une-migrante-dans-la (''La Voix du Nord'')]
*Uganda announces the plan to pass a [[Uganda Anti-Homosexuality Act, 2014|bill]] within weeks which potentially broadens the criminalisation of same-sex relations to include the [[capital punishment|death penalty]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/uganda-death-penalty-kill-the-gays-homosexuals-lgbt-a9151411.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.foxnews.com/world/uganda-kill-the-gays-bill-death-penalty (Fox News)]
*[[Censorship in Turkey]], [[Erdoğanism]]
**[[Ministry of the Interior (Turkey)|Turkey's Minister of the Interior]] [[Süleyman Soylu]] says almost 500 people were investigated and 121 have been detained for "insulting" the [[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria|Turkish offensive in Syria]] on [[social media]] and characterizing Turkey as an "invading" force. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/10/11/Turkey-says-121-detained-for-social-media-posts.html (AP via Al-Arabiya)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Foreign relations of Argentina]], [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Argentina]] announces it has severed diplomatic ties with the disputed [[Nicolás Maduro]]-led [[Government of Venezuela]] in favour of explicit recognition of opposition leader [[Juan Guaidó]] as interim [[President of Venezuela|president]] of [[Venezuela]] in the context of the [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]. [https://www.clarin.com/politica/gobierno-formaliza-ruptura-venezuela-maduro-da-representacion-plena-embajadora-guaido_0_7aU46_JN.html (''Clarín'')]
